d_vip: Never punished by Aegis's commands, and exempt from the locks and the security checks.
d_tru: Trusted members: exempt from the security checks (not from commands or locks).
d_mut: Muted members (can't send anything). Adding mutes them in Telegram; removing lets them talk again.
d_rst: Restricted members: text only — no media, stickers or links. Adding restricts them; removing lifts it.
d_ban: Banned members. Adding bans them; removing unbans them. Bans done in Telegram itself show up here too.
d_blk: Blacklist: banned now and again every time they join. Removing unbans them.
d_wrn: Members with active warnings. Adding gives a warning (the steps apply); open a member to remove or clear warnings.
d_qua: Quarantine: held muted until an admin releases them (removing releases).
d_sus: Members to keep an eye on: a note for the admins — Aegis doesn't act on this list.
d_mod: Moderators: members who may use /warn, /unwarn, /warns, /mute and /unmute in the group without being admins.
d_bot: Bots that may be added to the group (the «Adding bots» lock removes the others).
d_gwd: Words that never trigger the «Banned words» lock.
d_aln: Domains the «Links» lock and the anti-link check always allow.
d_fwd: Channels and chats whose forwards the «Forwards» lock allows.
d_stk: Sticker packs noted by the admins — Aegis doesn't delete by pack (the «Stickers» lock removes all stickers).
d_nam: Text in names that the security risk check flags.
home_intro: Each list belongs to this chat only. Tap one to view, add, search, export or see its history.
title: {icon} {name} — {title}
search_prompt: What should I look for in «{name}»? Send a word, a name, an id or part of a note.
note_prompt: Send the note for this entry (up to 200 characters), or «-» to clear it.
value_prompt: Send the new value for this «{name}» entry.
value_bad: That value isn't valid for this list. Try again, or /cancel.
value_exists: That value is already on the list.
remove_lifts_mute: This also lets them talk again in Telegram.
remove_lifts_restrict: This also lifts their restrictions in Telegram.
remove_lifts_ban: This also unbans them in Telegram.
remove_lifts_blacklist: This also unbans them, and they are no longer banned when they join.
remove_lifts_quarantine: This also releases them from quarantine in Telegram.
add_prompt_user: Who goes into «{name}»? Pick members with the button, forward a message from them, or send ids or known @usernames, one per line (up to {max}), each optionally followed by a note.
add_prompt_user_timed: Who goes into «{name}»? Pick members with the button, forward a message from them, or send lines like 123456789 1d spam @username 2h — an id or a known @username, an optional duration (30m, 2h, 1d, 1w; none = until lifted) and an optional reason. Up to {max} lines.
add_prompt_word: Send the words for «{name}», one per line (up to {max}).
add_prompt_pattern: Send the name patterns for «{name}», one per line (up to {max}).
add_prompt_domain: Send domains or links for «{name}», one per line (up to {max}), e.g. example.com.
add_prompt_chat: Send channels for «{name}»: @username, a t.me link or a -100… id, one per line (up to {max}) — or forward a post from the channel.
add_prompt_bot: Send bot usernames for «{name}» (they end in «bot»), one per line (up to {max}).
add_prompt_sticker: Send a sticker from the pack for «{name}», or pack names / t.me/addstickers links, one per line (up to {max}).
add_too_many: Only the first {max} lines were read.
add_nothing: Nothing usable in that message. Send it again, or /cancel.
note_only: ℹ️ A note for the admins: no lock or check acts on this list.
